title: 第17章 凡王府邸前壮观景象第18章 萧凡清点自己那点可怜的家当
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
李宝宝急忙挥动着双手，大声反驳起来：“姐姐，这次你家弟弟可是费了九牛二虎之力，好不容易才打听到一件惊天动地的大事情呢？
这不，一得到消息就连忙心急火燎地跑来告诉你和老爹啦！”
他的嘴巴还不停地微微抖动着，似乎有些不满自己被怀疑，嘴里小声嘟囔道：
“哼，老爹之前不是说陛下要给姐姐和六皇子凡王殿下赐婚嘛！
嘿嘿嘿……那这样一来，凡王殿下可不就是我李宝宝以后的亲姐夫喽！”
此时，正斜躺在软椅上悠闲自得地握着鱼竿的李元龙，缓缓睁开眼睛，似笑非笑地看了一眼李宝宝，
然后用一种不紧不慢的语气说道：“宝宝，你就别再跟你老爹还有姐姐在这儿故弄玄虚啦！赶紧把事情原原本本地讲出来！
究竟是什么样的事儿能让你如此慌忙慌张？”
李宝宝深吸一口气，稍微平复了一下情绪后，
方才继续说道：“哎！姐姐、老爹，我说的这件事可不得吖！
听说那六皇子凡王殿下竟然遭人下毒暗算了！你们说说看，这难道还算不上是件天大的事情吗？”
一旁的李秀宁一听这话，顿时满脸惊讶与好奇，
赶忙追问：“小弟，这么重要的消息，你又是从哪儿打听来的？快给我们讲一讲详细情况！”
李宝宝满脸兴奋地说道：“这消息可是从一家位于都城的饭馆里头听那说书先生讲的故事晓得的哟！
嘿嘿嘿！这不，在回咱镇国公府的路途当中，
大街小巷到处都有人在传唱一首民谣呢？
您猜怎么着？这首民谣说的正是六皇子凡王殿下遭人下毒的事儿呐！
恐怕这会儿，整个都城无论是那些达官显贵们，还是普通老百姓们，没有一个不知道这件大事儿啦！”
说完，
他调皮地冲姐姐眨眨眼，笑嘻嘻地道：“来来来！好弟弟，也给姐姐还有老爹唱上那么两句听一听？”

只见弟弟清了清嗓子，然后便扯起嗓门大声地朗读了起来：
“说大萧，道大萧，大萧之中有凡王！......一则传闻从天降，都中贵女将属他，......稀里糊涂中了毒酒，你说可悲，不可悲？”
这小家伙年纪虽小，但念起这民谣来却是字正腔圆、朗朗上口，
不到半分钟的功夫，
整首民谣就已经被他完整无误地念诵完毕啦！
原本满心期待能得到老爹和姐姐夸赞的李宝宝，
此刻却发现他们二人的脸色不知何时变得凝重起来，眉头紧紧皱在一起。
那张胖乎乎的小脸儿上满是机灵劲儿的李宝宝，
见此情形后，立刻像只乖巧的小兔子一般，迅速识趣地闭上了嘴巴，不敢再多言半句。
紧张的氛围并未持续太久，就在众人都还沉浸在这凝重气氛之中时，
镇国公李元龙那充满慈爱的目光缓缓转向了自己那满脸胖嘟嘟的宝贝儿子——李宝宝。
只见他轻声开口说道：“宝宝！如今你姐姐和爹爹我都有些不便亲自出面，
所以只能由你来代表咱们镇国公府，到六皇子凡王府的附近或者府内去探听一番消息，
看看这位六皇子凡王究竟是怎样一种状况，可好？”
那满脸胖嘟嘟的李宝宝一听到老爹给自己安排任务了，顿时两眼放光，
脸上洋溢着难以抑制的兴奋之情。
他毫不犹豫地用力拍了拍自己圆滚滚的胸脯，信誓旦旦地保证道：
“嘿嘿嘿！姐姐、老爹，您二位就放心吧！只管等着我的好消息便是！”
说罢，甚至连口水都顾不上喝，便心急火燎地朝着国公府门外飞奔而去。
而在他身后不远处，一名身材精瘦的老仆人见状，连忙加快脚步紧紧追赶了上去。

此时，池塘边的亭榭中，重新握起鱼竿准备继续享受钓鱼乐趣的李元龙，看着李宝宝远去的身影，嘴角不禁微微上扬，露出一抹怎么也止不住的笑容。
content_en:
Li Baobao hurriedly waved his hands and retorted loudly: "Sister, your brother spent a lot of effort this time and finally found out about an earth-shattering event?
No, as soon as I got the news, I rushed over anxiously to tell you and Dad! "
His mouth was still trembling slightly, as if he was dissatisfied with being suspected, and he muttered in a low voice:
"Hmph, dad didn't say before that His Majesty would grant a marriage to my sister and the Sixth Prince, His Highness King Fan!
Hehehe... In this case, His Highness King Fan will be my future brother-in-law, Baby Li! "
At this time, Li Yuanlong, who was lying on a soft chair and holding a fishing rod leisurely, slowly opened his eyes and glanced at Li Baobao with a half-smile.
Then he said in an unhurried tone: "Baby, stop playing tricks with your dad and sister here! Tell the truth as it is!"
What kind of thing could make you so flustered? "
Li Baobao took a deep breath and calmed down a little.
Just then he continued: "Hey! Sister, dad, what I said is inappropriate!
I heard that the Sixth Prince, His Highness King Fan, was actually poisoned and plotted! Let’s talk about it, isn’t this a big deal? "
When Li Xiuning heard this, his face was filled with surprise and curiosity.
He quickly asked: "Brother, where did you get such important news? Tell us the details!"
Li Baobao said excitedly: "I learned this news from the story told by the storyteller in a restaurant in the capital!
Hey hey hey! No, on the way back to the Duke’s Mansion in our town,
There are people singing a folk song everywhere in the streets and alleys?
Guess what? This ballad is about the sixth prince, His Highness King Fan, who was poisoned!
I am afraid that at this moment, no one in the entire capital, including the dignitaries and ordinary people, knows about this important event! "
After saying that,
He winked at his sister mischievously and said with a smile: "Come on, come on! My dear brother, why don't you sing a few lines for your sister and dad?"
My brother cleared his throat, then raised his voice and read aloud:
"Speaking of the Great Xiao, talking about the Great Xiao, there is a mortal king in the Great Xiao!... A rumor fell from the sky, and the noble girl in the capital will belong to him... He was accidentally poisoned by the poisoned wine. Do you think it is sad or not?"
Although this little guy is young, he recites this ballad with a clear and catchy tone.
In less than half a minute,
The entire ballad has been recited by him perfectly!
Baby Li, who originally fully expected to be praised by his father and sister,
At this moment, I found that their faces had become solemn without knowing it, and their brows were tightly knitted together.
That chubby little face is full of cleverness and energy.
After seeing this situation, he immediately closed his mouth like a well-behaved little rabbit, not daring to say another word.
The tense atmosphere did not last long. Just when everyone was still immersed in this solemn atmosphere,
The loving gaze of the town's Duke Li Yuanlong slowly turned to his chubby-faced precious son - Baby Li.
I saw him speaking softly: "Baby! Now it's a little inconvenient for your sister and father to come forward in person.
Therefore, you can only represent our Duke’s Mansion and go to the vicinity or inside the Sixth Prince Fan’s Mansion to find out some information.
Let’s see what kind of situation the sixth prince Mortal King is in, okay? "
When the chubby-faced Baby Li heard that his father had assigned him a task, his eyes suddenly lit up.
His face was filled with uncontrollable excitement.
He patted his round chest vigorously without hesitation, and vowed:
"Hey hey hey! Sister, dad, youDon't worry, you two! Just wait for my good news! "
After that, he didn't even bother to drink, and rushed towards the door of the Duke's Mansion in a hurry.
Not far behind him, a lean old servant saw this and quickly quickened his pace to catch up.
At this time, in the pavilion by the pond, Li Yuanlong took up the fishing rod again and was about to continue enjoying fishing. Looking at Li Baobao's retreating figure, the corners of his mouth could not help but rise slightly, revealing a smile that he couldn't stop no matter what.
